d:
Jharkhand VidhanSabha men utkrisht vidhayak samman milne ke bad niral purti ne kya kaha sunie?
Jharkhand vidhanasbha sthapna divas ke avsar par vidhayak niral purti ko utkrisht vidhayak samman se sammanit kiya gaya. samman milne ke bad unhonne apni khushi jahir ki aur is uplabdhi ko lekar kya kuchh kaha, sunie unka pura bayana.
